issues_confirmed: src/app/projects/DevilSuika/page.tsx:11 - handleCanvasClick casts e.target to HTMLCanvasElement, but the event fires on the viewport-sized overlay div at page.tsx:20-23, not the canvas. Drop-x is therefore a viewport coordinate passed into a canvas-local clamp (GameCanvas.tsx:24), landing ~240px right of the click on a 1280px window and saturating past x=800.

src/app/projects/DevilSuika/GameCanvas.tsx:114 - draw() re-arms itself via requestAnimationFrame but the effect cleanup at lines 119-122 only removes event listeners and never calls cancelAnimationFrame, while the effect depends on [mouseX] (line 123). Latent leak: currently masked because the overlay above prevents the canvas mousemove listener at line 58 from ever firing, so mouseX stays null. Fixing the input bug alone spawns one permanent rAF loop per mouse movement over the shared fruitsRef.
src/app/projects/DevilSuika/GameCanvas.tsx:69-74 - the translucent preview fruit is unreachable code, since mouseX is never set (same overlay cause).

package.json:9 - 'lint': 'next lint' is broken on Next 16. Ran it: 'Invalid project directory provided, no such directory: /home/laluboom/repos/01_active_projects/visesh-portfolio-v.2/lint'. next lint was removed in Next 16; the CLI parses 'lint' as a directory argument.

src/app/projects/page.tsx:16,30,37 - three of five project cards link to routes that do not exist. Verified against the running dev server: /projects/2048Game, /projects/js-mini-tools and /projects/how-i-built-my-portfolio all return 404.

src/app/layout.tsx:4-7 - metadata is still the create-next-app default. Verified in served HTML: '<title>My App</title>' and description 'Next.js with TailwindCSS and navbar'. No favicon either; src/app/favicon.ico was deleted in commit 9357fbd.

src/app/contact/page.tsx:9,31,39,49,59 - every contact detail is placeholder (you@example.com, github.com/yourusername, linkedin.com/in/yourprofile, yourportfolio.com). The site has no working contact path.

src/app/contact/page.tsx:8-12 - navigator.clipboard.writeText is neither awaited nor caught, and setCopied(true) runs unconditionally, so a rejected write (insecure origin, denied permission) produces an unhandled rejection while the UI still displays 'Copied!'.

src/app/home/Features.tsx:5-36 - landing-page carousel is placeholder: titles 'Trial 1' through 'Trial 5', with byte-identical descriptions at lines 20, 26 and 32. Links at lines 15, 21, 27 and 33 target /#designs and /#collabs, anchors that do not exist; src/app/page.tsx:8-10 renders only #hero, #features and #faq.

src/app/projects/DevilSuika/GameUI.tsx - orphaned file, imported nowhere. Calls (window as any).dropFruit at line 5, which nothing ever assigns (page.tsx uses the useImperativeHandle instead), and its Reset button at lines 17-19 has no onClick.

src/app/projects/DevilSuika/Fruits.ts:31-45 - update() handles only floor collision. No left/right walls, so resolveCollision can push fruit off-canvas horizontally with nothing to stop it. No ceiling or game-over condition, and no scoring anywhere in the game.

src/app/projects/DevilSuika/GameCanvas.tsx:100 - when two max-tier fruits merge, both indices are added to mergedIndices but the 'nextIndex < fruitTypes.length' guard pushes no replacement, so the pair silently vanishes.

src/app/projects/DevilSuika/Fruits.ts:60 - the 'dist !== 0' guard means perfectly co-located fruits never separate; merged fruits spawn at the exact midpoint (GameCanvas.tsx:101), making this reachable.
src/app/components/Navbar.tsx:21 - five links plus a text-3xl brand in a flex gap-8 text-lg row, with no 'hidden md:flex' and no hamburger anywhere in the file. Overflows on narrow viewports.

public/room/arcade.glb - 6.4 MB binary committed to git, loaded at arcaderoom/page.tsx:22 with Suspense fallback={null} (line 17) and no useGLTF.preload, so the user sees an indefinite blank canvas with no loading state.
